explanation: In Voltmarkt's bridge, mix has its own formula: SUM(V1 × M0) - SUM V1 × average M0. Computed that way, the effects add up exactly, which checks the work. Set as a plug, mix absorbs any error in price, cost or volume, and a wrong number looks like a shift in what customers bought. Mix can be non-zero with unchanged total units whenever the share of each product changes.
